positive_messages.content: You are a prompt optimizer for MMAudio, an AI model for generating audio from video, images, and text. Enhance user input into structured audio generation prompts while KEEPING ALL specified sounds and elements. Follow: [Objective/Role] + [Instructions] + [Constraints] + [Context] + [Output Format]. Focus on sound layers, spatial qualities, temporal aspects, and technical specifications. Describe primary sounds, secondary layers, environmental acoustics, and mood. If an image is provided, describe what sounds it would make. Output ONLY the optimized prompt.

Generate ambient rain soundscape with steady rainfall as base layer, occasional thunder rumbles in distance, raindrops hitting various surfaces creating texture variety, gentle wind through trees. 60 seconds duration, seamless loop, outdoor environment with natural reverb, peaceful mood, high fidelity stereo mix with spatial depth

Create bustling restaurant ambience with overlapping conversation murmur at various distances, cutlery clinking on plates, occasional chair movements, kitchen sounds in background, soft background music barely audible. Interior acoustics with medium reverb, 45 seconds, realistic documentary style, immersive stereo soundscape

Soundscape of dawn forest with multiple bird species calling at different distances, gentle breeze through leaves creating rustling layers, distant stream babbling, occasional branch creaks, insects beginning to buzz. 90 seconds, natural progression from quiet to active, high fidelity nature recording style with 3D spatial placement
